name: Niflheim
legendaryAbilityText: You may exhaust this card when you pass to choose another player; that player must discard 1 action card, then you and that player draw an action card.
legendaryAbilityFlavourText: "The mist... it's speaking to the crew." - NavVoice-Log 20332
flavourText: A world surrounded by a dense and chaotic nebula with unusually strong electromagnectic fields, visitors often experience strong mental distress while near this planet.
